meta.title: Repetition Guard
meta.description: Guards DeepSeek Harness streamed output against repetition: when the same string repeats up to the threshold (10 by default; Simple mode offers Strict 10 / Balanced 15 / Loose 30 presets) it opens a decision card while output keeps streaming; stop now, or allow this call to continue; without action it stops only after the repeats reach threshold x multiplier and the minimum reaction time has passed, and commits the partial answer. The card shows repeat progress and the reaction-time countdown; after Allow, a follow-up asks whether to whitelist the repeated text (also available from the recent-records viewer). Local providers are not force-stopped by default; an optional pause-display mode holds the hit chunk. Fenced, inline and indented code share one relaxed threshold; repeat counts can follow unit length through a piecewise table or a JS module; settings and derived values are written back automatically. Stop notices include an optional continue instruction and an opt-in browser system notification; optional JSONL stops/allows logs are visible in the settings-page recent-records viewer, with opt-in full content (redacted by default). Optional reasoning filler-word alert: only configured strings are checked by occurrences per 1k chars, and it suggests compressing the context or starting a new session without stopping output. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (Node >= 24.9), host API >= 0.1.1.
